name: Update Shared Drive
description: Update an existing shared drive. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/drives/update) for more information

configurable_props.name: useDomainAdminAccess
configurable_props.label: Use Domain Admin Access
configurable_props.description: Issue the request as a domain administrator

configurable_props.name: themeId
configurable_props.label: Theme ID
configurable_props.description: The theme from which the background image and color will be set. Cannot be set if `Color` or `Background Image Link` are used.

configurable_props.name: backgroundImageLink
configurable_props.label: Background Image Link
configurable_props.description: A link to the new background image for the shared drive. Cannot be set if `Theme ID` is used (it already sets the background image).

configurable_props.name: colorRgb
configurable_props.label: Color
configurable_props.description: The new color of this shared drive as an RGB hex string. Cannot be set if `Theme ID` is used (it already sets the color).

configurable_props.name: restrictions
configurable_props.label: Restrictions
configurable_props.description: A set of restrictions that apply to this shared drive or items inside this shared drive. See `restrictions` in the [Drive resource representation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/drives#resource-representations).
